messages:
Sara (AE): ACME Bank wants POC sign-off: SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning + RBAC per department + domain ownership proof. They asked if we can support multiple external IdPs for a single tenant (Okta + Azure AD). Need confirmation and pricing impact.
Felix (SE): We can, but depends on deployment mode. Hosted: we currently map by verified domain -> single IdP per org. Dedicated/Private: full multi‑IdP routing supported (config + routing table).
Sara (AE): Is multi‑IdP a feature flag or does it affect SLA/ops overhead?
Felix (SE): It's feature‑flagged on Dedicated/Private. No hard SLA hit, but ~10–15% more config/ops overhead for routing and metadata management. Hosted workaround: domain‑claim routing + relay_state is possible but fragile for IdP‑initiated flows.
Matt (Sales Ops): Pricing question — does multi‑IdP require reserved capacity or extra licensing?
Felix (SE): For enterprise customers we include multi‑IdP in the Enterprise license. For Hosted self‑serve customers we'd treat it as an "identity orchestration" add‑on (support contract + small per‑tenant fee). Dedicated customers typically get it with reserved capacity deals. I'll flag for pricing to include as an optional line item.
Priya (Security): Customer also requires: signed SAML assertions, optional encrypted assertions, per‑app ACS URLs, SCIM over mTLS, and audit logs for provisioning events. Confirm which are supported where.
Felix (SE): TL;DR: Hosted = SAML signed assertions supported, SCIM bearer token (TLS) only, audit logs retained per plan. Dedicated/Private = SAML signed/encrypted assertions supported, SCIM over mTLS supported, KMS/HSM integrations for keys, longer audit retention possible. Note SCIM rate limits: Hosted default 5k ops/hr/org (can be raised for Dedicated).
Felix (SE): For RBAC we support group->role mapping and attribute based mapping. Example SCIM->RBAC mapping we give customers as a template:
```json
{
  "scim_mapping": {
    "groups": {
      "engineering@example.com": ["infra-role","deploy-role"],
      "sales@example.com": ["sales-role"]
    },
    "user_attributes": {
      "email": "userName",
      "department": "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User:department"
    }
  }
}
```
Sara (AE): Next steps: Felix produce a 1–pager runbook + sample SAML metadata and SCIM mapping by EOD tomorrow. Matt to surface identity orchestration add‑on in the quote and call out Hosted vs Dedicated constraints. Priya to draft short answers for the security questionnaire focusing on SAML/SCIM/mTLS and data residency.
deploy-bot: Notice: sales-legal add‑ons template updated 2026-03-20.
Felix (SE): Will do. I'll also attach a small bash snippet for DNS TXT domain proofing and a checklist for IdP metadata we need from the customer.
Sara (AE): :thumbsup: Thanks all — I'll request ACME's SAML metadata + SCIM base URL and loop back once they reply.
